subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI render remote http/https Markdown image URLs directly from chat content, and if yes what privacy/security model should gate it?
rationale: Current code, tests, docs, and merged hardening intentionally prevent remote browser image fetches, while the request would improve UX by changing that security boundary.

options.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
options.body: Preserve the current default and require same-origin media, data/blob images, a managed proxy, or an explicit opt-in before remote images render.

options.title: Allow direct remote images
options.body: Accept the browser-fetch privacy tradeoff and update renderer, sanitizer/CSP, docs, tests, and browser proof together.

options.title: Fold into broader inline media policy
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/64607 to settle the complete inline-media policy before changing this focused path.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current default and require same-origin media, data/blob images, a managed proxy, or an explicit opt-in before remote images render.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is centered on the Control UI browser-fetch and CSP security policy that drobison00 most directly changed in merged history.
